text:
emma: quick sync — we need to finalize the pricing/quotas plan for Q3 roadmap planning. customer asks piling up; decision needed on flexible tiers vs simple overage model.
aj: can you share the customer asks we need to prioritize?
devon: enterprise customers want per-route burst limits and soft-overages for grace period; several startups asked for cheaper dev tiers.
emma: summary: 1) per-route quotas (api-key + route) 2) rolling minute-based burst caps 3) soft overage with invoice + opt-in 4) one low-cost hobby tier for adoption.
taylor: tradeoff is complexity in console + billing. each per-route quota adds UI + enforcement work and SRE alarms. estimate: 3 eng-sprints.
kavi: from product POV, must have clear launch criteria: docs updated, console UI for configs, billing ledger changes, and automated notifications to customers. no half-launch.
emma: launch criteria checklist suggestion: docs PR merged, console UX prototypes signed off, billing integration tests green, 10% load canary in prod for 2 weeks. thoughts?
aj: +1 to canary. also need rate-limit metrics in logs so customers can instrument fallback behavior.
devon: SRE-note: enforcement infra already has token-bucket primitive. per-route mapping is ~2 days infra work, then 5 days for console + billing hooks.
taylor: customer success asked for migration path from current hard limits to new tiers — need an automated opt-in and email rollout. add to scope.
kavi: OKRs: tie this to "reduce MTL by 20% for PLG signups" and "increase enterprise MRR via captive capacity tiers" — product should own the OKR.
emma: pricing proposals: (rough)
```
- Hobby: free 200k tokens/mo, 10 tpm (tokens/min)
- Developer: $49/mo, 2M tokens/mo, 100 tpm
- Team: $499/mo, 25M tokens/mo, 1k tpm
- Enterprise: custom, dedicated limits + per-route config
- Overage: $0.0006 per token after grace buffer (invoice monthly) or opt-in auto-charge
```
aj: numbers look ok but rework overage price to match unit economics after batching/quantization. also consider per-request unit for embeddings.
devon: enforcement note: we need to define behavior when hitting soft-overage: throttle to 10% until invoice settled? or return 429 with header X-Overage-Balance?
taylor: prefer 429 + clear header + UI banner. throttling surprises product teams.
kavi: rollout phases: phase 0 = internal beta (console+billing+docs), phase 1 = opt-in public (hobby+dev), phase 2 = default for new accounts, phase 3 = enterprise ramp. each phase has acceptance criteria.
emma: risks: billing disputes, accidental hard cutoffs, console confusion. mitigation: 30-day grace for legacy customers, dedicated CS playbook, and billing-bot alerting.
billing-bot: ALERT: test billing webhook failed in staging yesterday — devs assigned @devon.
devon: investigating; not blocking roadmap but gating for canary. will have PR by EOD.
aj: decision needed by EOW. my recommendation: approve scope for per-route quotas + soft overage opt-in, postpone auto-charge overage until next quarter.
taylor: agree. give engineering scope buffer for console polish.
kavi: i'll write the launch PRD and attach OKR. emma — can you assign owners?
emma: assigning: infra -> devon, console -> taylor, billing -> aj, docs & CS -> kavi. i'll create a follow-up thread for the PRD link + timeline. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
